subject.title: [Bug]: macOS onboarding rejects a logged-in Codex CLI on fresh installs

question: Should the remaining fix land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637, or should this maintainer-labeled issue be split into a narrower Codex runtime provisioning repair?
rationale: The root cause is narrow, but the issue has a protected maintainer label and is already paired with a broader open PR, so automation should not queue a duplicate repair or close the issue before maintainer direction.

options.title: Continue With Linked PR
options.body: Review and land the existing broad onboarding PR if its compatibility and auth-provider risks are acceptable.

options.title: Split Narrow Runtime Fix
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a focused PR that only moves Codex runtime provisioning before the setup live test and updates regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Waiting
options.body: Leave the issue open until the linked PR author resolves the current blocked state and maintainer review can continue.

recommendation.title: Continue With Linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the existing broad onboarding PR if its compatibility and auth-provider risks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and authored the linked candidate fix plus the recent onboarding/Codex history most connected to the failure.
